note: City of Williamsburg campground beside its Kentucky Splash waterpark (admission extra, closed off-season), off I-75 exit 11; sites include cable TV. Six tent sites. No generators. The campground borders a creek, so watch flash-flood warnings. --Claude
summary: Kept. Rates unchanged ($50/$55/$60 Apr-Oct, $40 Nov-Mar, $850/30 days in winter); extra person 6 adults included, $3 each; 7-night max, 3-night holiday minimum; books on Let's Bonfire. Not waterfront holds (small wooded creek). Pin on the waterpark parking lot ~100 m north of the loop.
flags: BOOKING: now online through Let's Bonfire (book.letsbonfire.com/kentucky-splash-waterpark-campground) - platform written as 'operator' (no Bonfire value in the list).
PIN: stored 36.72621,-84.17548 is on the waterpark parking lot; the RV loop is ~100 m south, ~36.7253,-84.1753 (under 250 m, optional).
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept - the creek the page mentions is a narrow stream under a tree line south of the loop.
LONG STAY: in season 'Max. Rental is 7 days'; the $850/30-day monthly rate applies only November-March - not a long-stay park.
SITES: 6 tent sites on the city page vs '5 tent sites' on the Bonfire page; count kept at 31 (25 RV + 6 tent).
STATUS: 'Waterpark and splashpad is closed for the season' - the campground itself stays open at winter rates.
